title: Gotrade Daily: Oil Spikes as Rate-Hike Fears Loom
summary: Wall Street opens September pressured by an oil spike from US-Iran escalation and firming Fed rate-hike expectations. Here is tonight's watchlist.
body_markdown:
Tonight the question is simple. Who benefits from the oil rally, and who feels the squeeze from rising yields.


## Tonight's Watchlist


Stock Movement What to Watch


[SLB](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/slb/) Mon up ~4% Energy's biggest gainer, most levered to oil through oilfield services


[CVX](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/cvx/) Mon up ~3% Chevron rides the oil rally and a possible Venezuela energy reopening


[XOM](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/xom/) Mon up ~3% ExxonMobil climbs; Trump signaled Exxon may enter Venezuela


[NVDA](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/nvda/) AI catalyst live A US$3.5B MediaTek stake and the Anthropic-Lambda cloud deal keep AI in focus


[GOOGL](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/googl/) Pressured, yields up Rate-sensitive, yet says its AI capacity still cannot be built fast enough


## Tonight's Catalysts


### Oil spike and the US-Iran conflict


Brent pushed back above US$90, up roughly 3% and briefly near US$91, after US forces struck missile launchers on Larak Island near the Strait of Hormuz. Energy was the only S&P 500 sector in the green, led by[XOM](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/xom/) ,[CVX](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/cvx/) , and[SLB](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/slb/) .


### The shadow of a Fed rate hike


The market now prices better-than-even odds of a rate hike at the Fed's mid-September meeting. The US 10-year Treasury yield rose to 4.76%, its highest since early 2025, while gold slipped to a two-week low.
